contest.measure_text: BY-DISTRICT COUNCIL ELECTIONS MEASURE CD: Shall the Ordinance be adopted adding Chapter 3 to Title 2 of the Municipal Code changing the City's electoral system for City Council elections from at-large to by-district elections in the districts reflected in Map 130? Supporters: None submitted Opponents: Burbank City Council.
